items.actClause: AN ACT to authorize the village of Mamaroneck, in the county of Westchester, to offer certain retirement options to certain police officers employed by such village
items.memo:
BILL NUMBER:  S6152

 TITLE OF BILL :
An act to authorize the village of Mamaroneck, in the county of
Westchester, to offer certain retirement options to certain police
officers employed by such village


 PURPOSE OR GENERAL IDEA OF BILL :
The purpose of this bill would authorize the Village of Mamaroneck, in
the county of Westchester, to offer certain retirement options to
certain police officers employed by the village.

 SUMMARY OF SPECIFIC PROVISIONS :
This bill would authorize the Village of Mamaroneck, to correct a
pension system matter on behalf of town police officers, Scott Fraioli
and Dominick Lanza. Both individuals were enrolled in the 375 (i)
program when they should have been enrolled in the 384 (i) retirement
program.

 JUSTIFICATION :
Both Scott Fraioli and Dominick Lanza were enrolled in the 375 (i)
program when they should have been enrolled in the 384 (i) retirement
program for reasons not ascribable to their own negligence and thus
failed to make a timely application to participate in such optional
retirement plan. The village of Mamaroneck may so elect by filing with
the state comptroller, on or before December 31, 2009, a resolution of
its legislative body together with certification that any such police
offer did not bar himself or herself from participation in such
retirement plan as a result of his or her own negligence. Thereafter,
any such police officer may elect to be covered by the provisions of
section 384-d of the retirement and social security law, and shall be
entitled to the full rights and benefits associated with coverage
under such section, by filling a request to that effect with the state
comptroller on or before December 31, 2009.

 PRIOR LEGISLATIVE HISTORY :
None.

 FISCAL IMPLICATIONS :
None.

 EFFECTIVE DATE :
Immediately after passage.

B.actClause: AN ACT to authorize the village of Mamaroneck, in the county of Westchester, to offer certain retirement options to police officers Scott Fraioli and Dominick Lanza
B.memo:
BILL NUMBER:S6152B

TITLE OF BILL:
An act
to authorize the village of Mamaroneck, in the county of
Westchester, to offer certain retirement options to
police officers
Scott Fraioli and Dominick Lanza

PURPOSE:
The purpose of this bill would authorize the Village of Mamaroneck, in
the county of Westchester, to offer certain retirement options to
certain police officers employed by the village.

SUMMARY OF PROVISIONS:
This bill would authorize the Village of Mamaroneck, to correct a
pension system matter on behalf of town police officers, Scott
Fraioli arid Dominick Lanza. Both individuals were enrolled in the
375 (i) program when they should have been enrolled in the 384 (i)
retirement program.

JUSTIFICATION:
Both Scott Fraioli and Dominick Lanza were enrolled in the 375 (i)
program when they should have been enrolled in the 384 (i) retirement
program for reasons not ascribable to their own negligence and thus
failed to make a timely application to participate in such optional
retirement plan. The village of Mamaroneck may so elect by filing
with the state comptroller, on or before December 31, 2010, a
resolution of its legislative body together with certification that
any such police officer did not bar himself or herself from
participation in such retirement plan as a result of his or her own
negligence. Thereafter, any such police officer may elect to be
covered by the provisions of section 384-d of the retirement and
social security law, and shall be entitled to the full
rights and benefits associated with coverage under
such section, by filling a request to that effect with the state
comptroller on or before December 31, 2011.

LEGISLATIVE HISTORY:
New Bill.

FISCAL IMPLICATIONS:
An increase of approximately $9,900 in the annual contributions of the
Village of Mamaroneck for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2011 and
past service cost of approximately $188,000 to the Village of
Mamaroneck as a one-time payment. This estimate is based on the
assumption that payment will be made on February 1, 2011.

EFFECTIVE DATE:
This act shall take effect immediately.

summary: Allows the Village of Mamaroneck to reopen the optional retirement plan offered under section 384-d of the retirement and social security law to police officers Scott Fraioli and Dominick Lanza.
